integrity: All numerical claims are determined by two independent exhaustive state-transition methods; extinction is also checked via the published cycle-circulation criterion. Local scripts and exact output data are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-state result for the eleven-vertex Grötzsch graph only; exhaustive computer-assisted proof is supplied. No generality for other Mycielski graphs is asserted, and historical priority remains subject to inaccessible or unindexed prior work.
title: Exact excitable-wave spectrum and basin geometry on the Grötzsch graph
